svg.title: AetherFlow v4.0.0 — System Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture showing Leptos WASM browser, Apache2 ingress, unprivileged aetherflow-api with its Rust workspace crates, runner.sock strict-allowlist IPC, root aetherflow-runner, bare-metal host targets, and the afpeer0 WireGuard mesh.

g.text: 12-crate Rust backend (backend-rs) · 4-crate Leptos WASM SPA (frontend-rs) · Zero-sudo privilege separation
Auth (HS256 JWT · TOTP · OIDC PKCE · CSRF) · Subdomain Gateway
WS Telemetry · McBrowser TUS/Editor · FlowAI · Plugins (21000..21999)
Separate from wg0 · 6-digit code pairing · af cluster diagnose
